description: This file defines the ResourceLoader class, which models the <resource-loader> element in an XML configuration related to the Apache OFBiz framework. It includes attribute parsing, validation, and accessor methods.

classes.name: ResourceLoader
classes.description: Models the <resource-loader> XML element with attributes for name, class, prepend-env, and prefix. Ensures attributes are non-empty and provides getter methods.

methods.name: ResourceLoader
methods.description: Constructor that initializes ResourceLoader from an XML Element, validating required attributes.

methods.name: getClassName
methods.description: Returns the class name associated with the resource loader.
